content.text: **Summary:** Ticket T-2002 is resolved. The `usage-exporter` pod in `analytics` was stuck in `ImagePullBackOff` because the `harbor-pull` image pull Secret was never created in the `analytics` namespace — Secrets are namespace-scoped and don't follow manifests across namespaces. The fix is to copy the existing `harbor-pull` Secret from `reporting` into `analytics` using `kubectl get secret … | sed … | kubectl apply`.
